ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Readings in Contemporary Latina/o Literary and Cultural Studies. Meets with ENG 473 This seminar examines recent work in the field of Latina/o literary and cultural studies. Our approach will entail putting novels, essays, short stories, and poetry in conversation with recent scholarship by Ariana Vigil, John Alba Cutler, Juana Mar�a Rodr�guez, Claudia Milian, Julie Avril Minich, Ram�n Rivera-Servera, Randy Ontiveros, and Deborah Vargas.
